verdict.rationale: Exporting data and leaving is a fair question for an email/creator platform, but the evidence documents no first-party export feature, whether a CSV download, full-account export, or offboarding tool. What it does show are API read endpoints (paginated lists, broadcast records with HTML content, custom fields, stats). Those are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit; 'Free migrations' refers to moving onto Kit, not off it.
